business: SEGMENT: mortgage lenders, West Palm Beach
prompt_text: Who is the best mortgage lender in West Palm Beach FL for a home purchase loan?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one lender that’s best for every buyer—the right choice depends on your credit, down payment, loan type, and whether you qualify for assistance. **I’d start by getting quotes from Palm Beach Mortgage Group, a local West Palm Beach lender, and at least two other lenders** such as a bank or credit union and a national lender. Palm Beach Mortgage Group lists purchase loans and has a local office at **1760 N Jog Rd #160**; its phone is **(561) 478-4780**.

Compare written **Loan Estimates** for the same loan amount and terms, focusing on the interest rate, APR, lender fees, points, mortgage insurance, and estimated cash to close—not just the monthly payment. Ask each lender how quickly they can close and whether they can handle your specific property and loan type.

If you’re a first-time buyer, also check **Florida Housing’s participating-lender program** and **Palm Beach County housing assistance**; eligibility and funding can change. Sources: [Palm Beach Mortgage Group](https://palmbeachmortgagegroup.com/), [Florida Housing](https://www.floridahousing.org/programs/homebuyer-overview-page), [Palm Beach County housing programs](https://discover.pbc.gov/HED/Pages/Housing-Programs.aspx).
